say:4:1510914002:1.text: Why... Why did you kill him? Why would you use divine power against a mortal?!
say:4:1510914002:1.source_cn: 为什么……为什么要杀了他……为什么要用神力对付凡人？！

say:6:1510914004:0.text: How could you have gotten hurt? You had my necklace; you were meant to be safe. Come back... With me, you're protected.
say:6:1510914004:0.source_cn: 有护身符的保护，你怎么会受到伤害？回来，回到我身边……...

say:12:1510914008:0.text: Ignorant apes! You think this is your land to claim? You trespassed, and now the Herdmaster will make you pay in blood!
say:12:1510914008:0.source_cn: 不识好歹的猿人。死到临头，还敢对兽群之主不敬！

say:13:1510914009:1.text: The day you marched into Wildborn lands, your fate was sealed.
say:13:1510914009:1.source_cn: 从侵略雅库伯尔的第一天起，你们早该想到今日的报应！

say:14:1510914010:0.text: Brave warriors, do not fear! The Wild Moon watches over us!
say:14:1510914010:0.source_cn: 英勇的战士，不要畏惧！雅库伯尔之月正庇佑着我们！

say:15:1510914011:1.text: Show the Halians what it means to enrage the herd, and avenge our fallen kin! Charge!
say:15:1510914011:1.source_cn: 上！杀光呼临人！为死去的同胞报仇，洗刷我们的屈辱！！

say:19:1510914012:0.text: Kordan's about to <style="highlight">launch a full-scale assault</style>!

say:20:1510914013:0.text: So are we doing this, or not? If no one's going to deal with the goddess, I'll take care of it myself.
say:20:1510914013:0.source_cn: 你们到底要不要对狩猎神出手？如果你们不去，我就自己去。

choice_prompt:21:1510914013.text: So are we doing this, or not? If no one's going to deal with the goddess, I'll take care of it myself.
choice_prompt:21:1510914013.source_cn: 你们到底要不要对狩猎神出手？如果你们不去，我就自己去。

say:22:1510914014:1.text: Nazrik, wait. As a Wildborn, you can't go yet. And your weapon was bestowed by Azora—you can't use it against her.
say:22:1510914014:1.source_cn: 那非，你顶着雅库伯尔人的面貌，现在不能过去。而且你的武...

say:23:1510914015:0.text: Take Gala. She's only just come to. Keep her away from the fighting and wait for our signal.
say:23:1510914015:0.source_cn: 加拉刚从昏迷中醒来没多久，你带她远离战场，等待我们的消息。

say:24:1510914016:0.text: Don't worry. <style="highlight">The Arcane Council will honor your wish.</style>

say:25:1510914017:0.text: ... Hmph. Then make sure you do.

say:29:1510914019:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is heading into the heart of the fight. I can't just—leave.

say:29:1510914019:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is heading into the heart of the fight. I can't just—leave.

choice_prompt:30:1510914019.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人要到前线去，我不能这样离开……！
choice_prompt:30:1510914019.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is heading into the heart of the fight. I can't just—leave.
choice_prompt:30:1510914019.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> is heading into the heart of the fight. I can't just—leave.

say:32:1510914021:0.text: I'll... I'll wait for you. You have to come back!
say:32:1510914021:0.source_cn: 我会等您。您一定……一定要回来！
say:32:1510914021:0.male: I'll... I'll wait for you. You have to come back!
say:32:1510914021:0.female: I'll... I'll wait for you. You have to come back!

choice:30:1:2.text: Don't worry, I'm a powerful mage too.
choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 别担心我，我也是强大的梅林
choice:30:1:2.male: Don't worry, I'm a powerful mage too.
choice:30:1:2.female: Don't worry, I'm a powerful mage too.

choice:30:2:3.text: You and Nazrik should stay safe.
choice:30:2:3.source_cn: 你和那非离战场远点，别再受伤

choice:30:2:3.female: You and Nazrik should stay safe.
